scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @fieldsync/server && npm run build -w @fieldsync/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:core && eslint --max-warnings 0 "packages/*/{src,test}/**/*.ts" "apps/server/{src,test}/**/*.ts" "e2e/**/*.{ts,mjs}" && npm run lint -w @fieldsync/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sync-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/test-kit/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sim/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:test-kit && npm test -w @fieldsync/test-kit && npm test -w @fieldsync/sync-core && npm test -w @fieldsync/sim && npm test -w @fieldsync/server
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && npm run build:test-kit && npm test -w @fieldsync/test-kit && npm test -w @fieldsync/sync-core && npm test -w @fieldsync/sim && npm run test:unit -w @fieldsync/server
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:test-kit && npm run test:integration -w @fieldsync/server
